name: rewind
description: List, restore, or snapshot git checkpoints. {"list":true,"session":"..."} lists state/rewinds, {"restore":"<hash>","session":"..."} runs git stash apply on a dangling snapshot, {"snapshot":true,"session":"...","tool":"..."} runs git stash create and appends the record (the host calls this before a mutating tool). Restore changes the working tree; pair with a session branch to rewind the transcript.
llm_description: List or restore a git checkpoint. {list:true, session?} lists state/rewinds. {restore:<hash>, session?} applies that snapshot to the working tree. Does not rewrite the conversation; fork/branch the session separately if you need the old transcript.

snapshot.description: git stash create and append a record

tool.description: tool name for a snapshot record
